Beilstein's organic-chemistry scope does not explicitly list computational chemistry; its current author guide makes experimental sections optional, and the official 2025 article https://www.beilstein-journals.org/bjoc/articles/21/94 is a concrete computational and existing-data precedent. The record does not generalize this into acceptance of all computational chemistry.

TÜBİTAK's generative-AI policy restricts generation of core findings or interpretations, requires disclosure and prohibits generative manuscript images. Beilstein distinguishes AI-assisted research from manuscript preparation but requires intellectual responsibility, human validation and disclosure and prohibits generative images. Manuscript-specific compliance requires a fresh policy check.
